corannulene-alc.root_cause: Large scientific regression: agent applies MuRepolarisation to every LF field scan and stops after failed whole-scan fits. It never attempts a local resonance fit, so the new bound-centre and background audit guidance is never reached. Coverage accepts an attempted failed recovery fit as covering each scan. General next work should distinguish monotonic recovery from non-monotonic local dips regardless of the initially requested fit model, and surface alternate local-resonance investigation when that model fails; do not equate a failed model with absence of the observable.
